Title: Multi-Modal Feature Extraction & Unified Latent Projection
Input_Datasets: Genetic: GSE28521 (N=116, 1000 features), Behavioral: Toddler Screening (N=880, 18 features), Environmental: Toxicological Matrix (N=47,768, 31 features)
Scientific_Scope_Limitation: Each modality is derived from distinct retrospective cohorts. Triplet combinations are mathematically integrated in-silico, not co-collected from individual clinical patients.

Title: WGAN-GP Minority Class Balancing & Distribution Manifold Modeling
Scientific_Scope_Limitation: WGAN-GP does NOT increase overall accuracy (-0.02% on seed 42, -1.69% mean). Contribution is strictly clinical sensitivity enhancement (+1.12%) and false negative reduction (-24.3%). Synthetic vectors are strictly confined to training data; zero synthetic vectors in test set.

Title: Hierarchical Attention Multimodal Integration Network (MINN)
Input_Datasets: 5,000 In-Silico Multimodal Test Combinations (G_te, B_te, E_te)
Aligned_Dimension: Level 1: 32-D intra-branch feature attention; Level 2: 3-D inter-modality attention (Beta)
Scientific_Scope_Limitation: Attention weights quantify mathematical model reliance, not biological causation. Labeling strictly standardized to 'Highest modality attention weight'.

Title: Explainability & Actionable Latent-Space Counterfactuals
Aligned_Dimension: Behavioral and Environmental 32-D Latent Coordinates (Delta G = 0)
Scientific_Scope_Limitation: Perturbations represent directional shifts in the 32-D latent manifold to reach P <= 0.35. They are mathematical explanations of model sensitivity, not direct clinical or medical interventions.
